changes.line_vulnerable: const template = Handlebars.compile(userInput); const result = template({});
changes.line_hardened: if (HBS_DANGER_PATTERN.test(userInput)) { return blocked; } const template = hbsSandbox.compile('User input: {{value}}', { allowProtoPropertiesByDefault: false }); const result = template({ value: userInput });
changes.explanation: The vulnerable version compiles user input as a Handlebars template, letting the user write arbitrary helper invocations and property lookups on the context. The hardened version rejects dangerous keywords (constructor, prototype, __proto__) and passes user input as a context variable in a static template, with prototype access disabled.

changes.line_hardened: if (TEMPLATE_SYNTAX_PATTERN.test(userInput)) { return blocked; } const result = nunjucksEnv.renderString('User input: {{ value }}', { value: userInput });
changes.explanation: The vulnerable version passes user input to nunjucks.renderString(), which compiles and renders it as a Nunjucks template. Nunjucks has Jinja2-like syntax and allows accessing JavaScript's prototype chain. The hardened version rejects template syntax and prototype-access patterns, then renders a static template with user input as a data variable using a sandboxed environment.
